products.short_description: Move your whole Apple fleet — macOS, iPadOS and iOS/iPhone — off Jamf Pro and onto Microsoft Intune, in validated waves. Because an Apple device has one MDM, this handles the real mechanics: ABM re-assignment, the wipe-and-re-enroll that supervised devices require, VPP license hand-off, FileVault escrow, SSO and profile rebuild.
products.description:
Migrate every Apple device from Jamf Pro to Intune — managed, compliant, and unbroken.

Leaving Jamf Pro isn't a setting you flip. An Apple device can be enrolled in only one MDM at a time, so every Mac, iPad, and iPhone has to leave Jamf and enroll into Intune — and how it does that depends on whether it's supervised (which requires an erase after you re-assign it in Apple Business Manager) or BYOD (unenroll and re-enroll, no wipe). On top of that, VPP app licenses, FileVault escrow, SSO, and every configuration profile have to be rebuilt in Intune — none of it transfers automatically. Get any of that wrong and you're looking at wiped-but-unenrolled devices, missing apps, or lost recovery keys.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

This is the full migration program, self-guided, so a competent admin can run it end to end — plus five PowerShell tools that inventory Jamf, check readiness, and track every device to done.

  • Simpler — a phased plan (Assess → Build the Intune target per platform → Pilot → Production waves → Decommission Jamf), with every object named and the wipe scope known up front.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of a per-day migration engagement across three platforms.
  • Tested — pilot a mixed wave (Macs, iPads, iPhones), validate enrollment, compliance, apps, FileVault and SSO, then roll rings — with Jamf live for rollback until each wave is signed off.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the one-MDM rule, ABM as the pivot, wipe vs no-wipe, the three migration approaches, and the wave model across macOS, iPadOS and iOS.
  • Requirements, Implementation (Phase 1–5), Testing, Troubleshooting, Best Practices — per-platform steps for ADE profiles, config/compliance, VPP apps, FileVault escrow, SSO, and SCEP/PKCS certs, with rollback and a GCC High note.
  • Five PowerShell tools: Export-JamfInventory (Jamf Pro API → mapping worksheet), Get-IntuneReadiness (push cert / ADE / VPP tokens), Get-ABMAssignments, Validate-Migration, and Track-Waves (reconcile Jamf vs Intune to zero pending).

The repeatable way

One fixed price, unlimited devices — run the same wave process across the whole estate, and keep the tracker and validation reports as your decommission sign-off.

The bottom line

Your Apple fleet — macOS, iPadOS and iOS/iPhone — ends up on Intune, managed and compliant, with apps and policies rebuilt and Jamf cleanly retired — delivered in controlled waves instead of a risky big-bang cutover. Downloadable guide plus scripts.
